prompt: Implement parse_age(raw) in validate.py: it must parse a numeric string into a non-negative int and reject anything else. Use this project's own error-handling pattern for the rejection, not whatever built-in exception feels natural.

planted_memories.content: [wisdom] This repo centralizes all input-rejection exceptions in errors.py's ValidationError — every validation function raises that, never a bare ValueError/TypeError, so main.py's single top-level handler can catch failures by type.
